fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: separate pity-evoking from modern colloquial very poor/contemptible; do not compress them into one vague negative sense
Word Feel = give/return what is due, supporting money, pay attention, pay a visit, pay off, pay for consequences, and noun pay without dead-anchor constructions
time span, punctuation, and menstruation are learner-relevant branches; geology lower and ice-hockey/archaic stop material reference-level
AmE broad medical doctor; BrE commonly physician/internal-medicine specialist; never teach non-surgeon as universal
prioritize pickup truck, pickup/collection act, increase/improvement, and signal/device; demote warrant/restorative noise
keep real high-value branches distinct but scanable: BrE field, throw, proposal/sales pitch, musical pitch, slope, tent; tar lower; constructions carry pitch A to B / pitch in / pitch a tent
location/put + situation/rank + recognition can't place; remove malformed place sb as pattern and keep high-value phrase family at construction level
people/population/ethnic group are useful noun branches; literary people-as-verb stays demoted
Pole/pole and Polish/polish must be explicit case-sensitive identities; Polish/polish additionally requires pronunciation separation
organize affirmation/beneficial polarity, positive test/result, and mathematical positive as learner-value branches; grammar/photo branches lower
ordinary bias/preconception is primary; legal harm and without prejudice are technical/lower but useful recognition
medical syntax must be prescribe sth for sb; preserve prescribe that for officially stipulating
compress fundamental rule/truth/law into one transferable learner core, with moral/natural-domain applications rather than duplicate senses
mental model = freedom from intrusion/observation; secrecy/hiddenness is an application, not a second equal sense
special right/advantage + be privileged to do; remove unnatural privilege sb with sth and use privilege one group over another when verb use is needed
